title: Proxmox
description: Proxmox VE node, VM, LXC, and storage metrics.

targets.expr: max by (device, model, serial, type, node) (pve_disk_power_on_hours{node=~"$node.*"})
max by (device, model, serial, type, node) (pve_disk_data_written_bytes{node=~"$node.*"})
max by (device, model, serial, type, node) (pve_disk_available_spare_percent{node=~"$node.*"})
